name: Jamaica
title: Holidays in Jamaica
intro: A Caribbean island of reggae, jerk chicken and seven-mile beaches, with waterfalls to climb and misty Blue Mountains to explore. Here's what Jamaica is like, when to go and how long to stay.
image_alt: A palm tree silhouetted against an orange sunset over the sea at Negril, Jamaica

facts.label: Time difference
facts.value: 5 hrs behind the UK (6 in summer)

facts_note: Most resorts are around Montego Bay, Negril and Ocho Rios. Hurricane season runs from June to November, peaking from August to October. Check entry rules on GOV.UK before you book.
when_to_go: Mid December to April is the best time, dry and sunny with a sea breeze, though prices are highest. May to November is hotter and wetter, with hurricane risk from August to October, but many days are still sunny and resorts are cheaper.

things.name: Seven Mile Beach, Negril
things.blurb: A long sweep of soft sand with calm water and beach bars.

things.name: Rick's Café
things.blurb: Cliff jumpers and sunset drinks on Negril's West End cliffs.

things.name: Dunn's River Falls
things.blurb: Climb the terraced waterfall hand in hand near Ocho Rios.

things.name: Blue Mountains
things.blurb: Coffee farms and hiking trails in cool, misty hills above Kingston.

things.name: Bob Marley Museum
things.blurb: The reggae legend's home and studio in Kingston.

things.name: Martha Brae rafting
things.blurb: Drift down a jungle river on a bamboo raft.

faqs.question: Where is the best place to stay in Jamaica?
faqs.answer: Negril for beaches and sunsets, Montego Bay for easy airport access, and Ocho Rios for waterfalls and activities.

faqs.question: Is Jamaica safe for tourists?
faqs.answer: Resort areas are generally safe, but crime is high in parts of Kingston and Montego Bay. Use licensed taxis and check GOV.UK advice.

faqs.question: How long is the flight to Jamaica from the UK?
faqs.answer: About 10 hours direct to Montego Bay or Kingston.

faqs.question: What food should you try in Jamaica?
faqs.answer: Jerk chicken and pork, ackee and saltfish, patties and fresh fish with festival dumplings.
